profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: I'm a web developer who is passionate about using language - coded, written or spoken - to solve problems. I work with Ruby on Rails, JavaScript (including jQuery and AJAX), HTML5, CSS3  and other technologies, and most recently wrote and published fauxster (http://rubygems.org/gems/fauxster), a Ruby gem with over 400 downloads.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Maintained and developed REST API (Ruby on Rails)
Added features to mobile front-end (Objective-C)
Created a Google Chrome extension (JavaScript)
Worked with Twitter and Facebook API’s
Built a task-scheduling app using Sidekiq and Redis

positions.title: Marketing Associate
positions.description: I was responsible for business development and helped coordinate a long-term email marketing campaign. I also wrote and maintained the end-user help system.

positions.title: Vice President of Event Planning (VA Theta)
positions.description:
Planned and executed all chapter activities ranging from social and special events for 113 members and guests to creative motivational activities, parents weekends and recruitment events.
Participated in ongoing continuing education in the areas of leadership, mentoring, and coaching at international training seminars and convention workshops.
Coordinated a three-day visit for regional advisors and a one-day leadership academy for chapter officers.
Planning experience includes vendor negotiation, contract reviews, transportation logistics, budgeting.

volunteerExperiences.description:
RailsBridge is an organization to make coding more accessible to groups underrepresented in tech.

As an instructor at RailsBridge workshops, I've worked primarily with students brand-new to coding to set up development environments and walk through introductory tutorials.

Read more: http://railsbridge.org/about

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Washington and Lee Alumni Admissions Program
volunteerExperiences.description: I interview students applying to Washington and Lee University primarily to identify cultural fit. Of the three students I interviewed last year, one was accepted and chose to attend.

company.name: Washington and Lee Alumni Admissions Program
